name: Born Again Christians
overview: Scripture reveals that becoming a born again Christian is essential for entering the kingdom of God, as Jesus teaches that one must be born again—born of water and the Spirit—to see and enter God's kingdom (John 3:3, 5). This new birth is not merely a profession of faith but a spiritual transformation aligned with doing the will of the Father (Matthew 7:21). Rooted in the divine nature of the Word, who was with God and is God (John 1:1), this new birth is made possible through God's love demonstrated by the giving of His only begotten Son, so that whoever believes in Him will have eternal life (John 3:16).
